chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Sayābah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, in the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام it is stated: “If a man were to cut the private part of a woman, I would impose upon him compensation equal to her indemnity for her. Then if he did not pay the indemnity to her, I would cut his private part for her, if she requested that.”

key_terms.دِيَتَهَا: her indemnity compensation for bodily injury
key_terms.طَلَبَتْ: she requested, indicating the injured woman’s demand
key_terms.قَطَعْتُ: I would cut, indicating retaliatory legal punishment
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: the recorded legal text attributed to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man mutilates a woman’s private part according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal ruling from the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning severe bodily injury to a woman’s private part. It establishes financial liability through diyah and, upon non-payment and her demand, allows retaliatory bodily punishment as qiṣāṣ.
